method.fold: Each change is measured against the player's own earlier games this season and net of the league-wide change over the same dates. A change is listed when it clears a bar set so that, in 2023 to 2025 for pitchers and 2024 to 2025 for swings, about 1 listed change in 34 came from game-to-game noise alone; today's list expects about 0.39 from noise. Descriptive: this is what changed, not what comes next.
